name: ATM Transaction Status 2 Code
definition: Status of the amount presented to the customer in the last bundle.

FULL.name: Full
FULL.definition: Total presented amount is equal to the amount to dispense.

PART.name: Partial
PART.definition: Total presented amount is lower than the amount to dispense.

NONE.name: None
NONE.definition: Total presented amount is equal to zero.
